notes: Captured blank, after JavaScript rendered. No personal data.
Zero native <select> elements: all ten dropdowns are react-select comboboxes, i.e. input[type=text] with role=combobox. This is the current Greenhouse default and the reason the combobox path exists.
No element carries a name attribute, so field signatures fall back to id.
Question ids are per-posting (question_<numeric>), so a taught mapping on one GitLab posting will not transfer to another. That is a known limitation, not a fixture artefact.
Long EEOC prose was trimmed; every form control and the structure around it is untouched.

mustNotMatchWhy.question_37845851002: "Are you currently located in the United States?" is a yes/no about location, not a country field. Filling it with a country name would be wrong.
mustNotMatchWhy.question_37763350002: Employment agreements and post-employment restrictions - nothing in the profile answers this.
mustNotMatchWhy.question_37763353002: "Have you previously worked at GitLab?" - profile has no employer-specific history flag.

notQuestionsWhy: Comboboxes have a fixed option list and belong to the fill path. Sending them to a model as essay questions is what made drafting slow and useless before isCombobox was added.
